navigation.safety_body: Keep your eyes on the road and follow posted signs and limits. Set up the route before you drive and do not type while moving. Road restrictions are only as complete as the map data.
navigation.using_last_route: Directions unavailable — following the last route
navigation.vehicle_limits_all: Route avoids roads too low, narrow or weak for this vehicle
navigation.vehicle_limits_none: Vehicle size and weight are not checked by this routing service
navigation.vehicle_limits_size: Route checks this vehicle's height, width and weight (not length, axles or hazmat)
